title: The HA Green's owner and every repo that loads it adopt the shared-machine convention
why: Part 2 of c140 (shared machine names one owner), from your HA Green problem, Oct 27 13:15 CDT (cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh2RSWZr4XsNtpstx8kVFBn66).
note: home-app (owner, holds home since Oct 26) writes the box-health preflight and the hold record, and writes it once; degen's deploy script moves from home's tools into degen (ruling Oct 27 13:22 CDT, see c140); degen, and later mailaudit, declare the box and run the preflight before a deploy, a restart or a bulk import. The live fixes (map-fetch ban, freeze-hold rule, push add-on retries, degen load cuts) stay with the home and degen sessions already on them. Deferred (shiv, Oct 27): it changes other repos. Asked: waiting page item 2 (yes to the one plan). Due after: c140. Port: this is the port. Placed ahead of r5 (triage, Oct 27): the crash risk is live now. Shape from c140's lane (Oct 28): each repo adds a shared-resources entry to its extras file (the HA Green names owner shivinate7/home-app and the preflight path there) and runs lint/check_shared_resources.py in CI.
